title: Kubernetes overview
description: The cluster at a glance: nodes, namespaces and pods, CPU and memory used against requests and allocatable, and network by namespace and node. Namespaces and nodes link to their own views. docs/design/observability.md.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Nodes whose kubelet reports Ready.

panels.title: Nodes not ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is false or unknown.

panels.title: Namespaces
panels.description: Namespaces in the cluster.

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods in phase Running.

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods whose readiness probe fails. Completed Job pods are never ready and are left out.

panels.title: Restarts, 24 h
panels.description: Container restarts in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: CPU used
panels.description: Busy CPU on the cluster nodes as a share of what they can allocate to pods.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use on the cluster nodes (total less available) as a share of what they can allocate to pods.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores busy on the cluster nodes, cores requested by running and pending pods, and cores the nodes can allocate (dashed).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory in use on the cluster nodes, memory requested by running and pending pods, and memory the nodes can allocate (dashed).

panels.title: Top namespaces by CPU
panels.description: The ten namespaces using the most CPU now. Click one to open it in Namespaces.

panels.title: Top namespaces by memory
panels.description: The ten namespaces with the largest container working set now. Click one to open it in Namespaces.

panels.title: CPU by namespace
panels.description: Cores each namespace's containers use.

panels.title: Memory by namespace
panels.description: Working set of each namespace's containers.

panels.title: Nodes, worst first
panels.description: One row per node, not ready first, then busiest CPU. Used and requested are shares of what the node can allocate to pods. Click a node to open it in Nodes.

targets.expr: max by (node) (kube_node_role{role="control-plane"}) or on (node) 0 * max by (node) (kube_node_info)

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

sum by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", node!=""} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", node!=""}) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Running|Pending"} == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.title: Nodes not ready
panels.description: Each node while its Ready condition is not true. Reads None while every node is Ready.

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: Pods in each phase. Succeeded is completed Job pods.

panels.title: Resource counts
panels.description: Objects of each kind across the cluster. NetworkPolicies are Kubernetes ones; Cilium's own policies are not counted.

panels.title: Restarts by namespace
panels.description: Container restarts in each interval, per namespace. Reads None while nothing restarts.

panels.title: OOM kills by namespace
panels.description: Containers the kernel killed for exceeding their memory limit, per namespace. Reads None while nothing is OOM-killed.

panels.title: Network by namespace
panels.description: Bits per second each namespace's pods send (above zero) and receive (below zero). hostNetwork pods are left out: they report their node's whole traffic, once per pod.

targets.expr: 8 * sum by (namespace) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace!=""}[$__rate_interval]) unless on (namespace, pod) kube_pod_info{host_network="true"})
8 * sum by (namespace) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace!=""}[$__rate_interval]) unless on (namespace, pod) kube_pod_info{host_network="true"})

panels.title: Network by node
panels.description: Bits per second each node sends (above zero) and receives (below zero) on its physical interface.
